title: ShelterDataPrep (Version 0.5.1)
description: Config-driven preparation of animal shelter intake and outcome extracts for length-of-stay analysis.  A run is one YAML settings file, and produces the prepared data alongside a processing ledger that records every row removed or changed, a value-level breakdown of each filter and mapping, descriptive statistics of the finished set, and a provenance log.
notes: If you use this software, please cite it as below.  If you use the Orange County and Los Angeles County data that the shipped configs cover, also cite the deposit it comes from: 10.5281/zenodo.22051091 for the raw extracts, or 10.5281/zenodo.22051368 if you took the prepared files rather than preparing them yourself.
references: Mavrovouniotis ML. Use of Kaplan-Meier and Cox regressions in the distribution of length of stay in animal shelters for pre-specified calendar periods: Definition, computation, and examples of dog length of stay in Orange County California. PLOS ONE. 2026;21(1):e0342102. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0342102
